note: Fish schools (plan C, design/FISH_AND_FISHING_PLAN.md section 2 and 4): computed from a hash of (cell, slot, game day), never saved, never an entity. count_weights = chance of 0, 1, 2, 3 schools in a 128 m cell that has water. A school is placed on a point whose water kind (server_fish_water.gd) suits its species, up to place_tries tries, else it does not exist. Radius 3 to 8 m. The centre drifts drift_m metres around its base over drift_period_game_s and is held at the base when the drift would leave suitable water. factor: 1.0 inside the radius, 0.5 within 2x, 0.15 outside. species_by_kind: species names must exist as items; one that does not (salmon until the fish items land) is left out. only_in: species -> seasons it appears in.
